name: "Styling standards"
description: "Styling and design-token standards for the chosen styling system."
applyTo: "{src,app,web,client}/**/*.{css,scss,less,ts,tsx,jsx,vue,svelte}"
---

# Styling standards

- Use the project styling system; do not introduce a second one.
- Style through design tokens and shared utilities, never one-off hex values.
- Keep responsive and dark-mode behaviour in the token layer, not in components.
- Styling system: Tailwind CSS.
